text:
laura_sales: Kestrel Health asking for SOC2 cover page + ISO excerpt and a signed external-scan attestation for their EU staging POC. Deadline Thu COB CET. Also want a Dedicated EU vs Hosted breakdown for data residency and a cost delta.
chris_se: Copy. Do we have an up-to-date SOC2 redacted PDF we can share for presales? Also need to know whether we can promise KMS in eu-west-1. @emma_security @oli_devops
emma_security: We have a redacted SOC2 summary and an ISO excerpt we use for presales. I can sign the external-scan attestation template for POCs. If they want the pen-test letter with customer-facing wording, route to legal.
laura_sales: Customer contact: procurement@kestrel-health.eu (Marta K). They specifically said logs and encryption keys must remain in EU. No diagrams requested.
oli_devops: Dedicated + customer-managed KMS in eu-west-1 satisfies keys/logs in EU. Hosted currently stores logs multi-region; we can't claim single-region residency on Hosted. Lead time KMS + IAM: ~48 hours. Pricing sketch: `dedicated-small: €7,800/mo`, `kms: €210/mo`, `one-time-setup: €2,500` (3mo commit halves setup).
chris_se: Good — will add those numbers to the quote. Is external vulnerability scan acceptable for procurement instead of full pen-test?
emma_security: For a POC, external blackbox scan + attestation is acceptable. I'll add a clarifying sentence in the attestation: "External vulnerability scan sufficient for POC; production readiness may require full engagement."
laura_sales: Kestrel asked about vulnerability remediation SLA for critical findings in the scan — they want 7 business days. Can we commit?
emma_security: We cannot guarantee remediation windows for customer application code. For our infra findings we can commit to triage within 3 business days and remediation where applicable within 5 business days; I'll document that. Recommend adding a joint runbook note for customer-owned fixes.
chris_se: Can you upload the SOC2 excerpt + attestation and share presigned links? Need to send to Marta by EOD.
emma_security: Uploaded: `SOC2_Kestrel_excerpt_redacted.pdf` and `external_scan_attestation_Kestrel.docx`. Links below (expire in 7 days).
legal-bot: file uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/SOC2_Kestrel_excerpt_redacted.pdf (expires in 7 days)
laura_sales: Great. I'll send to Marta (procurement@kestrel-health.eu) and note the Dedicated cost + EU KMS option and lead time. If they ask for a signed pen-test letter stub, who signs?
emma_security: I can sign the attestation for presales POCs. If legal redlines to add warranty disclaimers or broader scope, CC legal@redwood.com. Minor redlines ok.
oli_devops: Ops note: if they want event logs forwarded to an EU SIEM, that increases egress costs; call that out in the quote.
laura_sales: Noted — I'll flag potential egress in the quote. Thanks everyone, will update once Marta replies. :white_check_mark:
